description: This is a JUnit test class for the UserCreatedShelfUtils component of the Book Project. It tests the functionality related to user-created shelves, including creating shelves, adding books, and retrieving books from shelves. The class utilizes Spring's dependency injection and annotation-based configuration for integration testing.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfUtilsTest
classes.description: Test class for the UserCreatedShelfUtils functionality, utilizing Spring Boot's testing framework to verify shelf and book management features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data, including creating shelves and adding books before each test.

methods.name: resetServices
methods.description: Clears the data in book and shelf services to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: createSetOfBooks
methods.description: Creates and saves a set of books with specified titles, associating them with shelves.

methods.name: createAndSaveBook
methods.description: Constructs a Book object with given title, shelf associations, and saves it via the BookService.

methods.name: addBooksToCustomShelves
methods.description: Adds a predefined set of books to specific user-created shelves for testing.

methods.name: returnBooksSuccessfully
methods.description: Test to verify that books are correctly retrieved from a custom shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksIfNoBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Tests that an empty set is returned when no books are present in a shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksForNonExistentCustomShelf
methods.description: Verifies that requesting books from a non-existent shelf yields an empty set.
